targets.outcome_computational_quote:

mathematical, data, or reporting errors, however, and the materials were expertly

targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
This analysis found publication bias reduced the effect size in three of the
       eight meta-analyses to such a degree that these findings failed to replicate.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Publication-bias corrections materially weaken three highlighted effects. The report says no errors were found but does not explicitly establish recovery of the originally reported numerical outputs. The umbrella review is the target; underlying meta-analyses are components of its data, not additional independently targeted papers.
